title: Eduardo Domínguez Explains Atlético-MG's Comeback Against Cruzeiro
seoTitle: Domínguez Reveals Atlético-MG's Comeback Strategy vs.
subtitle: Argentine coach reveals how daily dialogue changed the strategy in the Copa do Brasil semifinal
excerpt: After the 2-1 victory over Cruzeiro, Eduardo Domínguez details the role of dialogue with players in the tactical shift that secured qualification.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Argentine coach Eduardo Domínguez gained prominence by revealing, in an interview, the behind-the-scenes details of Atlético-MG's comeback against Cruzeiro, a match that secured their qualification for the Copa do Brasil semifinals. The account highlighted to the public the importance of daily dialogue with athletes to adjust the strategy on the field.

The Role of Daily Dialogue in Team Preparation

Domínguez emphasized that, since his arrival at the club, he has built a relationship based on constant dialogue with the players. According to him, "we believe strongly in the day-to-day" and active listening to the athletes are fundamental for adapting the work to the group's possibilities.

How the Half-time Conversation Changed the Formation

During the derby, the team fell behind on the scoreboard, and at half-time, the coach received suggestions from the players themselves about where they felt most comfortable. Bernard was instructed to play more on the left flank, and Kevin Castañón was moved to a more central area. Domínguez stated that "they told me they would feel more comfortable that way.">

Impact of the Tactical Change in the Second Half

The new arrangement of the players had an immediate effect. After the reorganization, Atlético-MG managed to reverse the result: Victor Hugo equalized, and Fred scored the winning goal, sealing a 2-1 victory. The triumph secured qualification for the semifinals, while the first leg had ended in a 1-1 draw at Mineirão.

Atlético-MG's Next Challenges in the Competition

With qualification confirmed, the Belo Horizonte club awaits the definition of their opponent in the semifinals. Grêmio and Internacional will face each other on Thursday, and the winner will advance to play Atlético-MG in the next stage of the Copa do Brasil.

With information from Terra.
